market_definition: The expanded polypropylene foam market comprises moulded, closed-cell polypropylene bead foams that combine energy absorption with recyclability. It measures sales of EPP beads and moulded parts. BY PRODUCT FORM: Beads, Moulded Parts, Blocks & Sheets. BY DENSITY: Low (< 30 g/L), Medium (30–60 g/L), High (> 60 g/L). BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive Bumpers & Energy Absorbers, Reusable Packaging, Toys & Consumer Goods, Building & Sports Equipment, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Extruded polypropylene foam; expanded polyethylene and EPS; polypropylene resin sold unexpanded. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
